description: Company lookup by name, website domain or Wikidata id: official website, founding date, country, headquarters, industries, CEO, founders, parent, employee count, stock tickers and LEI, from Wikidata (CC0). No match is an uncharged 404. Use to enrich a lead, vendor or counterparty with company data, or to ground an answer about a business. Example: name=Spotify. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
